solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/reverse-string-ii/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

541. Reverse String II

Given a string s and an integer k, reverse the first k characters for every 2k characters counting from the start of the string.

If there are fewer than k characters left, reverse all of them. If there are less than 2k but greater than or equal to k characters, then reverse the first k characters and leave the other as original.

Example 1:

Input: s = "abcdefg", k = 2
Output: "bacdfeg"

Example 2:

Input: s = "abcd", k = 2
Output: "bacd"

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 10^4
    s consists of only lowercase English letters.
    1 <= k <= 10^4
"""


class Solution:
    def reverseStr(self, s: str, k: int) -> str:
        arr = list(s)
        n = len(arr)
        for start in range(0, n, 2 * k):
            end = min(start + k, n)
            arr[start:end] = reversed(arr[start:end])
        return "".join(arr)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.reverseStr("abcdefg", 2))  # "bacdfeg"

assert sol.reverseStr("abcdefg", 2) == "bacdfeg"
assert sol.reverseStr("abcd", 2) == "bacd"

assert sol.reverseStr("", 1) == ""
assert sol.reverseStr("a", 1) == "a"
assert sol.reverseStr("ab", 1) == "ab"
assert sol.reverseStr("abc", 2) == "bac"
assert sol.reverseStr("abc", 3) == "cba"
assert sol.reverseStr("aaaaaa", 2) == "aaaaaa"
assert sol.reverseStr("zzzzzzzzzz", 5) == "zzzzzzzzzz"
assert sol.reverseStr("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", 13) == "mlkjihgfedcbanopqrstuvwxyz"
assert sol.reverseStr("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", 1) == "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
assert sol.reverseStr("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", 26) == "zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba"
assert sol.reverseStr("abcde", 10) == "edcba"
